views.Source: Five hub libraries show HUB and USB1..5 with original volume names; both native USB sources retain stock cyan USB badges. Native ordering remains player/slot order, so it need not be numerical.
views.Browse: Hub USB1 and continuously connected USB2 headers observed; native USB1 Browse header restores the stock USB icon with no HUB header.
views.Waveform: H USB1/USB2 observed with native USB1 on the other deck; both two- and four-deck layouts inspected. Same deck replacement with native USB1 removes H, and replacement back to hub restores H USB2.
views.Link: Candidate started with Link Off; native UI changed to On. Hub and native labels remain scoped in both modes. Existing hub warning triangle after a loaded mode change remains; seamless mode switching is not claimed.

selector.presentation: Dark Eject USB panel, neutral borders, subdued selection, matching numbered badges and volume names, Cancel / BACK and Eject; no physical hub-port labels.
selector.input: Short STOP opens selector; encoder moves selection; BACK and Cancel / BACK close it without ejecting.
selector.individual: Loaded HUB_LIB2 / USB1 ejected: backing sdd1 and its private alias removed, success targets=1 sources=0x1. Other USB2..5 retain their numbers. Cached loaded identity remains H USB1 with native warning.
selector.selected_removal: Selected HUB_LIB4 / USB3 physically disconnected via QMP while selector open. Selection was cleared; Eject reports USB changed. Open the selector again. No different disk was ejected; remaining native and hub mounts retained. Reattachment restored that library without renumbering continuously connected sources.
selector.whole_hub: Long STOP2 (1.7seconds) closes selector and performs background whole-hub eject: four remaining backings sde1/sdf1/sdg1/sdc1 removed, success targets=4 sources=0x1e. Final Source contains native USB1/2 and MOD MENU only; both native backings remain mounted. Cached hub deck still displays H USB2.
selector.notice_scope: Preparing notice observed; final completion established by success logs and absent mounts, not by dialog dismissal. No captured audio or full-track playback claim.

input_fault_negative.observation: Coordinator confirmed core log: frame filters disabled after exceeding 200 microseconds eight times; selector subsequently refused input ownership.
input_fault_negative.interpretation: Input health conservatively latches a fault when a valid panel read does not advance either expected filter serial. Idle age alone does not cause refusal.
input_fault_negative.cause: Unestablished. The budget fault does not by itself attribute the slowdown to the badge or selector changes.
input_fault_negative.followup: Normal framework apply with empty decks started PID573204; selector input, cancellation, individual and whole-hub eject subsequently passed on the unchanged candidate.

external_presentation.adapter_negative_control: All three production widget families:96 same-controller owned/unowned/owned cycles pass plain and ASan/UBSan, preserving original native description/image and clearing TLS ownership. This is host-adapter evidence.
external_presentation.synthetic_runtime: Bounded isolated peer received native framing and sent39 discovery,137 status and39 media messages, but no external Source row appeared and no native media query occurred. Fixture is incomplete; no external runtime presentation pass is claimed.

external_presentation.remaining: Actual external-CDJ Source/Browse/Waveform acceptance remains unvalidated. Native USB runtime controls and host ownership controls support the narrowly scoped UI candidate, not full external-device interoperability.
